faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: Villa Mona Lisa, Budva, Montenegro (mountain villa above Budva). Open in Google Maps
faq.q2: What's the best airport to fly into?
faq.a2:
For most international guests, Podgorica Airport (TGD) is the best option (typically the easiest for international connections).

You can also fly into Tivat Airport (TIV) — it's closer to Budva and can be very convenient depending on your route (especially for some European flights).
faq.a3: May 24, 2026 — Pre-party / Welcome day • May 25, 2026 — Wedding day • May 26, 2026 — After-party
faq.a4: Elegant semi-formal. Our color palette includes sky blue, soft mint, and sunshine yellow tones. Please note: white and ivory are reserved for the bride.
faq.q6: How do I get to Budva?
faq.a6: There are lots of options: Taxi / private transfer, Bus, or Car rental. If you'd like help choosing the best option for your arrival time (or coordinating with others), just reach out to us.
faq.a7: Budva has plenty of great options — hotels, Airbnbs, and apartments. If you want recommendations based on your preferences (close to the beach, quieter area, walkable, budget-friendly, etc.), message us and we'll help you pick something.
faq.q8: Do I need a visa to visit Montenegro?
faq.a8: No visa is required for Canadian or Ukrainian passport holders for tourist travel to Montenegro.
faq.q9: What will the weather be like?
faq.a9: Late May on the coast is usually warm and sunny. Expect around ~20°C during the day, but it can feel chilly at night, especially up at the villa. We recommend bringing a light sweater or jacket for evenings.
faq.a10: Montenegro uses the Euro (€). We recommend having some cash, especially for taxis and small purchases (cash is often preferred).
faq.q11: Will food and drinks be provided?
faq.a11: Yes — food and drinks will be provided at all events listed in the schedule. If you have dietary restrictions or allergies, please make sure you note them in your RSVP (especially allergies).
faq.a12: No gifts needed — your presence is the best gift. If you still feel like doing something meaningful, you absolutely can — but please don't feel any pressure.
